text: The sponsor, think of a municipal climate fund or an operator's own budget, defines the authorised scope, milestones, the evidence the verifier will require, an approved repair provider, and an independent verifier.

The terms are hashed, and the hash and the funds go into an escrow contract: two real transactions on our local Anvil chain. The contract itself refuses unapproved providers, and any verifier who's also a party.
